NONE: › something that has no value or that does not work
› not working or not having any value

example: Are there any more batteries? This one's a dud.
還有沒有電池？這個電池用完了。
He's made eleven movies in the last 20 years and not one has been a dud.
在過去的二十年裡他一共拍了十一部電影，每一部都是精品。
A customer had tried to pay with a dud cheque (= one for which a bank will not give money).
有個顧客想用一張假支票蒙混過關。
Some dude just asked me if I knew you.
剛才有個傢夥問我是否認識你。
[ as form of address ] Dude, where were you last night?
小子，你昨天晚上去哪裡了？

NONE: › a farm in the US that offers activities such as riding horses and camping
› If you do something in high dudgeon, you do it angrily, usually because of the way you have been treated.
（通常指因受到的待遇而）怒氣沖沖地，非常氣憤地

example: After waiting an hour, he drove off in high dudgeon.
等了一個小時後他怒氣沖沖地開車走了。
